Messages.Author: pallando
Messages.Body:
can an uncontrolled vampire have more blood on him than his capacity?

i know that at the end of the influence phase full vampires are moved to the
controlled region; blood in excess of the capacity drains off.

but as far as i have understood there can be more blood on an uncontrolled
vampire. it could also be moved back to the pool.

thanks for the help

pallando

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
pallando wrote:
>
> can an uncontrolled vampire have more blood on him than his capacity?

Yes.

> i know that at the end of the influence phase full vampires are moved to the
> controlled region; blood in excess of the capacity drains off.

Yes, a rule which indicates rather explicitly that excess blood is possible.

> but as far as i have understood there can be more blood on an uncontrolled
> vampire. it could also be moved back to the pool.

It can be transfered back to the pool by spending transfers before the end
of the influence phase in which he (mandatorily) comes out, yes.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"pallando" <pall...@NOSPAM.gmx.at> wrote in message
news:a19hcq$uso$1...@bird.wu-wien.ac.at...

> can an uncontrolled vampire have more blood on him than his capacity?

Yes.
You can Govern at superior to put 3 counters on Normal.

> i know that at the end of the influence phase full vampires are moved to the
> controlled region; blood in excess of the capacity drains off.

Correct.

> but as far as i have understood there can be more blood on an uncontrolled
> vampire. it could also be moved back to the pool.

You may use 2 transfers to move 1 counter off of the uncontrolled vampire
and put it into your pool. You may use 4 transfers to move 2 counters
in the same fashion. You may use 6 transfers to move 3 counters in
the same fashion.

Carpe noctem.
